protocol.timing: ORT session.run plus coordinate conversion and WGPU local affine fit; image decode/resize measured separately; reference preparation amortized across target frames
protocol.profile_scope: one profiled identical-image inference per model, diagnostic only; ORT event durations are not hardware GPU timestamps

profile.notes: The eight CPU ScatterND nodes form a coarse-matching chain; each outputs the full bool tensor [1,48,80,48,80] (14,745,600 bytes), with rank-6 update indices ending in five coordinates. A replacement must preserve the staged mask construction. Copy event duration may include queue waits and synchronization.

raco_buffer_cache_mode_bucket_alternatin.conclusion: No speedup; bucket was 4.2% slower in this sample.

raco_iobinding_ort_webgpu_values.conclusion: No speedup; outputs were exactly equal in this run.
raco_iobinding_ort_webgpu_values.interop_note: Inputs were ORT-owned WebGPU OrtValues; no zero-copy sharing with wgpu-py buffers was tested or established.

efficientloftr_preferred_layout.conclusion: NHWC, already used by the benchmark, was about 12.7% faster than NCHW; no change needed.

efficientloftr_validation_mode.conclusion: About 0.3% faster with validation disabled, within run-to-run noise.

efficientloftr_flattened_scatternd_graph.transform: Reshape each rank-5 ScatterND into flat data/updates and rank-2 one-dimensional indices, then restore the data shape.
efficientloftr_flattened_scatternd_graph.test_pair: Live-DIC frame 100, 640x360 network input padded to 640x384
efficientloftr_flattened_scatternd_graph.conclusion: Rejected: exact output on the tested pair, but ScatterND remained on CPU, added CPU nodes and host copies, and did not improve profiled wall time.

optimization_trials.graph_capture: Not enabled: measured graphs contain CPU fallback operators. Current native WebGPU EP documentation requires static shapes and all kernels on WebGPU; match output cardinality also changes between image pairs.

efficientloftr_fullres_global_similarity.note: Dense global similarity alone; excludes all other activations and scratch buffers.

limitations: No GPU allocation high-water measurement is exposed by this ORT trace on this setup; process RSS is host memory, not VRAM.
ORT trace event durations are cumulative and may include synchronization; they must not be interpreted as pure device execution time.
These models were tested at 640x360 input, not network inference at native 4K.
The 4K global coarse-plus-local refinement pipeline is not implemented or measured yet.
